recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create a single-file mobile browser visual novel called **Vessel Room: Rite of Small Inconveniences**. Preserve the source loop exactly: start overlay, animated canvas, tap-to-advance typewriter dialogue, one two-choice branch, route completion overlay, and restart. Do not add score, movement, collision, health, inventory, or extra branching.

Theme the game as a satirical possession-horror vigil in a claustrophobic bedroom. The focal visual identity is a levitating possessed vessel over a bed, surrounded by candles, sacred cross light, wax seals, sigils, cracked wallpaper, ash, and green infernal glow. The player is a junior rite operator choosing between a solemn sacred command and a bureaucratic loophole. Keep mobile portrait readability and large touch targets.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Truth
The preserved source (`index_old.html`) is a mobile visual-novel style browser game. It boots to a start overlay, starts a canvas animation loop after a button click, reveals dialogue with a typewriter effect, lets the player tap the dialogue panel to finish or advance lines, presents exactly one two-button choice, transitions to a route, then shows a terminal overlay with restart.

## Protected Mechanics
- Native click/tap start and restart controls.
- Dialogue panel tap advances text or completes the active typewriter reveal.
- Choice buttons are generated at the final line of the branching scene and route to target scene IDs.
- Canvas redraws continuously only while the game is active.
- No collision, movement, health, inventory, score, or numeric win/loss model exists.
- Ending semantics are route completion plus restart, not failure scoring.

## Remix Blueprint
Rebuild the same mechanic loop as a possession-horror ritual transcript. The start overlay becomes an emergency rite briefing; the canvas becomes a claustrophobic exorcism room; the single character draw becomes a possessed vessel manifestation; the branch becomes two ritual strategies; the ending overlay becomes a containment log.

## Safe Transformation Surfaces
Copy, HUD labels, speaker names, scene names, canvas background art, procedural character form, palette, typography, particles, button styling, audio volume, and state feedback are safe to transform.

## Mobile Requirements
Portrait-first layout, large touch targets, readable type, non-blocking ambient effects, and native tap/click handling are required.
